Double-wide Container Garage

Need a garage big enough for two vehicles, a full workshop, or safe storage? A double-wide container garage with roll-up doors gives you all that and costs less than a traditional brick-and-mortar build.

At NEW BRAND, our double-wide garage is constructed from two high-grade Corten steel containers placed side by side, with the shared interior wall removed to create one open, drive-in space. The result is a weather-tight, low-maintenance structure that goes up in days, not months.

What Is a Double-Wide Container Garage?

Unlike single-container garage options, the double-wide container garage configuration provides realistic door clearance. A double-wide container garage combines two standard containers — typically two 20-ft units or two 40-ft units — arranged side by side to create a wide, open structure. Once the center wall is cut and reinforced, you're left with a single open bay that comfortably fits two full-size vehicles, trucks, SUVs, or a work area.

Frame Corten steel for rust-resistant, impact-resistant, designed for 20+ years of service
Interior Wall Removed and reinforced with structural steel headers
Floor Standard steel container flooring; epoxy coating available as an upgrade
Roof Original container roof sealed and waterproofed; pitched roof or lean-to overhang available
Insulation EPS foam panel or mineral wool for temperature control (other insulated panels option)
Ventilation Louvered vents or vents to prevent moisture and condensation
Electrical and Lighting - Pre-wired conduit runs available for easy local hookup
- LED overhead lighting packages available
Finishes - Exterior: Powder-coated paint in any RAL color
- Interior: steel, painted, or paneled
Access - Two independent roll-up garage doors (one per bay) — standard
- Single wide roll-up door option - Side entry personnel door optional

A double-wide container garage gives you commercial-grade steel construction, faster installation, and long-term portability that a stick-built garage can't match. See how much you can save—request a quote for a container garage today!

Who Is the Double-Wide Container Garage Built For?

- Two-car Parking: Side-by-side parking for full-size sedans, pickup trucks, or SUVs.

- Home Workshop: Enough floor space for workbenches, tool storage, and a vehicle lift.

- Boat or RV Storage: Taller and wider configurations available on request.

- Agricultural or Farm Storage: Tractors, ATVs, and seasonal equipment.

- Commercial or Industrial Use: Parts storage, service bays, or equipment staging.

Customization Options for Double-wide Container Garages

Every NEW BRAND's double-wide container garage is built to your spec. Common upgrades include:

• Epoxy Flooring: Easy to clean, slip-resistant, professional finish

• 2 Story Space: Add overhead storage or a loft office

• Solar Panels: Pre-wired mounting points for off-grid setups

• Security System: Reinforced door frames, deadbolts, security cameras

• HVAC Rough-in: Ready for mini-split installation

Frequently Asked Questions

1
How wide is a double-wide container garage?
A standard double-width configuration uses two 20-foot containers, resulting in an external width of approximately 16 feet. Once the internal framing is complete, there is enough space to park two standard-sized vehicles side by side, with ample room to open the doors. We also offer wider custom configurations.
2
Can a double-width container garage accommodate two full-size trucks?
Yes, provided the configuration is appropriate. Placing two 40-foot containers side by side provides approximately 40 feet of depth and a clear internal width of 14–15 feet. This is sufficient to accommodate two full-size pickup trucks. For very wide vehicles (such as trucks with raised chassis or dual-rear-wheel pickup trucks), we recommend customizing a wider specification.
3
What is the Foundation of the Double-wide Container Garage?
A level concrete slab or compacted gravel pad is required. Dimensions should match or slightly exceed your container footprint.
4
Do I need a building permit for a container garage?
Permit requirements depend on the local regulations in your area. Many local authorities classify container structures as temporary or accessory structures, but some jurisdictions may require a full building permit. We always recommend that you consult your local planning or building department before installation.
5
How long does it take to install a double-wide container garage?
Once your foundation is ready and the containers are delivered, installation typically takes one to three days for a standard configuration. Custom modifications completed at our factory mean minimal on-site work.
6
Can the double-wide container garage be relocated?
Yes. One of the biggest advantages of container construction is portability. If you move or need to reposition the structure, it can be loaded onto a flatbed and transported to a new site. Foundation work will be required at the new location.
